spec.title: Vitrine
spec.description: The metrics of Vitrine, from docs/administrator/metrics.md.

spec.expr: max by (job, version) (vitrine_build_info{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) unless max by (job, version) (vitrine_build_info{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} offset 10m)

spec.title: Pages / s
spec.description: Pages requested, all Routes selected.

spec.title: 5xx pages
spec.description: Share of pages that answered 5xx.

spec.title: Render p95
spec.description: How long 95% of the pages took to render.

spec.title: Cache hit ratio
spec.description: Cache reads that found an entry, fresh or Stale.

spec.title: Source failures
spec.description: Calls to Sources that answered 5xx or failed without an answer.

spec.title: Warm-up problems / run
spec.description: Pages with problems that a warm-up finds, on average.

spec.title: 5xx ratio
spec.description: Share of pages that answered 5xx. Alert on this one.

spec.title: Source call failures
spec.description: 5xx and failed calls to each Source, as a share of its calls.

spec.title: Version that runs
spec.description: vitrine_build_info: one band per pod and version, to tie a regression to a deploy. A rollout shows pods of two versions side by side.

spec.title: 5xx ratio by version
spec.description: `vitrine_build_info` joined, pod by pod, to the 5xx ratio: each line is a release, even while a rollout runs two at once.

spec.expr: sum by (job, version) (rate(vitrine_http_requests_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",status_class="5xx"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(job, instance) group_left(version) max by (job, instance, version) (vitrine_build_info{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"})) / sum by (job, version) (rate(vitrine_http_requests_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(job, instance) group_left(version) max by (job, instance, version) (vitrine_build_info{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, job, version) (rate(vitrine_render_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(job, instance) group_left(version) max by (job, instance, version) (vitrine_build_info{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"})))

spec.title: Share of pages by Route
spec.description: Average pages per second over the selected time range.

spec.title: Unmatched requests / s
spec.description: Requests that matched no Route (404): `route="unmatched"`. A rise is a broken link, or a scanner.

spec.title: Render duration distribution
spec.description: Pages per bucket of `METRICS_BUCKETS`: the darker, the more pages. The top bucket holds the slowest.

spec.title: Routes over the selected time range
Calls / s by outcome
spec.description: `error` is a call that failed without an answer, such as a timeout, or whose body failed halfway.

spec.title: Calls by type of Source
spec.description: The `source` label is the type: `gitlab`, `harbor` or `nexus`.

spec.title: Failure ratio by Source
spec.description: 5xx and failed calls over all calls.

spec.title: Failure ratio over the selected time range
4xx ratio by Source
spec.description: Calls refused: a token that expired, a project that does not exist.

spec.title: Failed calls / s by Source and outcome
p95 by outcome
spec.description: Calls that fail without an answer run until their timeout.

spec.title: Hit ratio by Source
spec.description: Reads of a Source answered from a fresh entry. A miss called the Source.

spec.title: Entries
spec.description: Measured by Vitrine at most every 30 seconds, by each pod. A shared store, such as redis, reads the same from every pod: the lines overlap. A drop to 0 is a flushed store.

spec.title: Bytes
spec.description: `memory` and `files` report it, `redis` does not: it takes a command per key.

defaults.noValue: Not reported by the redis store

spec.title: Write errors / s
spec.description: Writes that failed: the store is down or full, and Visitors pay for it with slower pages.

spec.title: Runs
spec.description: Warm-ups the servers ran over the selected time range: each pod runs its own, so 3 pods run 3 times as many.

spec.title: Runs per hour
spec.description: Only the warm-ups the servers run from `warmUp` in Settings are measured. Each pod runs its own, so the count is that of all pods.

spec.title: URLs found per run
spec.description: Distinct URLs of Vitrine that warm-ups saw. A fall is pages that went missing from the Sources.

spec.title: Pages with problems per run
spec.description: Pages whose list of problems was not empty. A rise right after a deploy is the deploy; one that follows an outage of a Source is the Source.

spec.title: CPU by pod
spec.description: CPU seconds per second: 1 is one core. User and system time, stacked.

spec.title: Resident memory by pod
spec.description: A line that climbs between two restarts is a leak.

spec.title: Event loop lag p99 by pod
spec.description: A loop that lags delays every page that pod serves, whatever Route.

spec.title: Restarts by pod
spec.description: Changes of process_start_time_seconds over the selected time range: a container that restarted inside its pod. A pod that a deploy replaces is a new instance, not a restart.

spec.title: Age by pod
spec.description: Seconds since each process started: it falls back to 0 at a restart, and a new pod starts from 0.

spec.title: Scrapes by pod
spec.description: `up`: 0 while Prometheus could not scrape a pod. A pod that a deploy replaces ends its row, and the new one starts another.

spec.title: Log lines
spec.description: Lines the selected pods logged over the selected time range.

spec.title: Starts
spec.description: Pods that logged `Starting Vitrine`: each deploy, restart or crash.

spec.title: Starts by instance
spec.description: A pod that a deploy replaces is a new instance; one that crashed and restarted inside its pod logs a start again under the same instance.

spec.title: Lines per level
spec.description: The level is a label of the stream, so this is cheap to ask even for a week.

spec.title: Most frequent errors over the selected time range
Starts by version
spec.description: `Starting Vitrine` carries the version: a deploy replaces every pod, a crash restarts one.

spec.title: Sources that could not be loaded
spec.description: One line per failed read of a Source. The Source is the start of the cache key.

spec.expr: sum by (source) (count_over_time({job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",level="error"} |= "Could not load a Source" | json | label_format source=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/.*" .key "" }}` [$__auto]))

spec.title: Why a Source could not be loaded
spec.description: The message of the error of each failed read.

spec.expr: sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (cause) (count_over_time({job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",level="error"} |= "Could not load a Source" | json cause="error.message" [$__range]))))
sum by (msg) (count_over_time({job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",level="error"} |~ "Cache store could not" | json [$__auto]))

spec.title: Pages whose Template failed
spec.description: The most frequent paths of `Template failed`.

spec.title: Pages that failed a warm-up, per hour
spec.description: `Warm-up page failed`, one line per page. The metric `vitrine_warmup_pages_with_problems_total` counts the same pages.

spec.title: Warm-up duration by pod
spec.description: The `seconds` of the summary, `Warm-up finished`, of each pod: the longest of each hour.

spec.expr: max by (instance) (max_over_time({level=~".+",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} |= "Warm-up finished" | json | unwrap seconds | __error__="" [1h]))

spec.title: Share of pages that failed a warm-up

spec.expr: sum(sum_over_time({level=~".+",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} |= "Warm-up finished" | json | unwrap failed | __error__="" [1h])) / sum(sum_over_time({level=~".+",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"} |= "Warm-up finished" | json | unwrap pages | __error__="" [1h]))
sort_desc(topk(10, sum by (problem) (count_over_time({job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",level="error"} |= "Warm-up page failed" | json problem="problems[0]" [$__range]))))

spec.title: Logs
spec.description: One JSON object per line, as Vitrine writes them. Level and Search filter them: Search is a regular expression, case-insensitive, such as `gitlab.*503`. Click a line for its fields.

spec.title: Sources, cache and pages, from the logs
